67315-twenty-talks-to-teachers.title: Twenty Talks To Teachers
67315-twenty-talks-to-teachers.creator: Unknown
67315-twenty-talks-to-teachers.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The talks that follow are addressed to young teachers. They treat everyday problems in a homely way. I have tried to be plain and pointed. I have omitted long terms. I do not speak of correlation, apperception, spontaneity, etc., and I omit long psychological terms. You get enough of these in county institutes and educational journals.

arxiv-1907-01367.title: Lipper: Synthesizing Thy Speech using Multi-View Lipreading
arxiv-1907-01367.creator: Yaman Kumar, Rohit Jain, Khwaja Mohd. Salik, Rajiv Ratn Shah, Yifang Yin, Roger Zimmermann
arxiv-1907-01367.description: Abstract Lipreading has a lot of potential applications such as in the domain of surveillance and video conferencing. Despite this, most of the work in building lipreading systems has been limited to classifying silent videos into classes representing text phrases.

arxiv-1907-12738.title: Gravitational Collapse of Baryonic and Dark matter
arxiv-1907-12738.creator: Dipanjan Dey, Pankaj S. Joshi
arxiv-1907-12738.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Dipanjan Dey, Pankaj S. Joshi. A massive star undergoes a continual gravitational collapse when the pressures inside the collapsing star become insufficient to balance the pull of gravity. The Physics of gravitational collapse of stars is well studied. Using general relativistic techniques one can show that the final fate of such a catastrophic collapse can be a black hole or a naked singularity, depending upon the initial conditions of gravitational collapse.

arxiv-2011-05663.title: Optimal Synchronization Control for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems: Online Adaptive Learning Solutions
arxiv-2011-05663.creator: Yuanqiang Zhou, Dewei Li, Furong Gao
arxiv-2011-05663.description: Abstract This paper presents an online adaptive learning solution to optimal synchronization control problem of heterogeneous multi-agent systems via a novel distributed policy iteration approach. For the leader-follower multi-agents, the dynamics of all the followers are heterogeneous with leader disturbance.

arxiv-2104-01215.title: The Coronavirus is a Bioweapon: Analysing Coronavirus Fact-Checked Stories
arxiv-2104-01215.creator: Lynnette Hui Xian Ng ID, Kathleen M. Carley ID
arxiv-2104-01215.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lynnette Hui Xian Ng ID, Kathleen M. Carley ID. The 2020 coronavirus pandemic has heightened the need to flag coronavirus-related misinformation, and fact-checking groups have taken to verifying misinformation on the Internet. We explore stories reported by fact-checking groups PolitiFact, Poynter and Snopes from January to June 2020, characterising them into six story clusters before then analyse time-series and story validity trends and the level of agreement across sites.

arxiv-2212-04038.title: SkipFuzz: Active Learning-based Input Selection for Fuzzing Deep Learning Libraries
arxiv-2212-04038.creator: Hong Jin Kang, Pattarakrit Rattanukul, Stefanus Agus Haryono, Truong Giang Nguyen, Chaiyong Ragkhitwetsagul, Corina Pasareanu, David Lo
arxiv-2212-04038.description: Abstract Many modern software systems are enabled by deep learning libraries such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. As deep learning is now prevalent, the security of deep learning libraries is a key concern. Fuzzing is a promising direction to find library vulnerabilities. Fuzzing deep learning libraries presents two challenges.

arxiv-2305-03131.title: Courant-Nijenhuis algebroids
arxiv-2305-03131.creator: Henrique Bursztyn, Thiago Drummond, Clarice Netto
arxiv-2305-03131.description: Abstract . We introduce Courant 1-derivations, which describe a compatibility between Courant algebroids and linear (1,1)-tensor fields and lead to the notion of Courant-Nijenhuis algebroids. We provide examples of Courant 1-derivations on exact Courant algebroids and show that holomorphic Courant algebroids can be viewed as special types of Courant-Nijenhuis algebroids.

arxiv-2308-04355.title: Evaluation of a Low-Cost Single-Lead ECG Module for Vascular Ageing Prediction and Studying Smoking-induced Changes in ECG This work was supported in part by the UK Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) grants: EP/X040518/1 and EP/T021020/1.
arxiv-2308-04355.creator: Syed Anas Ali 1 , Muhammad Saqib Niaz 1 , Mubashir Rehman 1 , Ahsan Mehmood 1 , M. Mahboob Ur Rahman 1 , Kashif Riaz 1 , 2 , Qammer H. Abbasi 3 , 4
arxiv-2308-04355.description: Abstract Vascular age is traditionally measured using invasive methods or through 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG). This paper utilizes a low-cost single-lead (lead-I) ECG module to predict the vascular age of an apparently healthy young person. In addition, we also study the impact of smoking on ECG traces of the light-but-habitual smokers.

arxiv-2406-13376.title: Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning: First Imitate, then Improve
arxiv-2406-13376.creator: Adam Jelley, Trevor McInroe, Sam Devlin, Amos Storkey
arxiv-2406-13376.description: Abstract Supervised imitation-based approaches are often favored over off-policy reinforcement learning approaches for learning policies offline, since their straightforward optimization objective makes them computationally efficient and stable to train. However, their performance is fundamentally limited by the behavior policy that collected the dataset.

arxiv-2411-02590.title: Rate of convergence of a semi-implicit time Euler scheme for a 2D Bénard-Boussinesq model
arxiv-2411-02590.creator: Hakima Bessaih, Annie Millet
arxiv-2411-02590.description: Abstract . We prove that a semi-implicit time Euler scheme for the two-dimensional Bénard-Boussinesq model on the torus D D converges. The rate of convergence in probability is almost 1/2 for a multiplicative noise; this relies on moment estimates in various norms for the processes and the scheme.

arxiv-2507-03232.title: Inferring the neutron star equation of state with nuclear-physics informed semiparametric models
arxiv-2507-03232.creator: Sunny Ng ID, Isaac Legred ID, Lami Suleiman ID, Philippe Landry ID, Lyla Traylor, Jocelyn Read ID
arxiv-2507-03232.description: Abstract Over the past decade, an abundance of information from neutron-star observations, nuclear experiments and theory has transformed our efforts to elucidate the properties of dense matter. However, at high densities relevant to the cores of neutron stars, substantial uncertainty about the dense matter equation of state (EoS) remains.

arxiv-2605-10079.title: SocialDirector: Training-Free Social Interaction Control for Multi-Person Video Generation
arxiv-2605-10079.creator: Liangyang Ouyang, Ruicong Liu, Caixin Kang, Yifei Huang, Yoichi Sato, [2pt] The University of Tokyo

pmc-10742737.title: Endoscopic Biliary Drainage in Surgically Altered Anatomy
pmc-10742737.creator: Marco Spadaccini, Carmelo Marco Giacchetto, Matteo Fiacca, Matteo Colombo, Marta Andreozzi, Silvia Carrara, Roberta Maselli, Fabio Saccà, Alessandro De Marco, Gianluca Franchellucci, Kareem Khalaf, Glenn Koleth, Cesare Hassan, Andrea Anderloni, Alessandro Repici, Alessandro Fugazza, Keisuke Iwata
pmc-10742737.description: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) is considered the preferred method for managing biliary obstructions. However, the prevalence of surgically modified anatomies often poses challenges, making the standard side-viewing duodenoscope unable to reach the papilla in most cases. The increasing instances of surgically altered anatomies (SAAs) result from higher rates of bariatric procedures and surgical interventions for pancreatic malignancies.

pmc-11483738.title: Molecular-Level Understanding of Phase Stability in Phase-Change Nanoemulsions for Thermal Energy Storage by NMR Spectroscopy
pmc-11483738.creator: Jungeun Park, Ulrich Scheler, Robert J Messinger
pmc-11483738.description: Phase change materials (PCMs) are latent heat storage materials that can store or release thermal energy while undergoing thermodynamic phase transitions. Organic PCMs can be emulsified in water in the presence of surfactants to enhance thermal conductivity and enable applications as heat transfer fluids. However, PCM nanoemulsions often become unstable during thermal cycling.

pmc-12585967.title: Innate immunity in tumors: roles and therapeutic targets
pmc-12585967.creator: Songze Leng, Yuyue Ren, Yaoyao Tian, Weiwei Zhao, Yue Mou, Xingyu Chen, Hong Zhou, Wei Wang
pmc-12585967.description: Innate immune cells and pathways are central to shaping the tumor microenvironment (TME), where they influence tumor growth, metastasis, and responsiveness to immunotherapy. Although research on innate immunity in cancer has expanded considerably, the mechanisms driving immune dysfunction remain incompletely understood.

pmc-13372863.title: Julio Óscar Trelles Montes (1904–1990)
pmc-13372863.creator: João Pedro do Couto Caetano, Isadora Wiegand Mascarenhas, Alice Alves Petry
pmc-13372863.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Admitted by competitive examination in 1929 to the internship of the Seine asylums, he was drawn into the orbit of the Dejerine Foundation and became an assistant and then head of the laboratory directed by Jean Lhermitte (1877–1959), where he absorbed the anatomo-clinical method of the French school; working almost always at his master’s side between 1930 and 1935, he produced the body of work that established his reputation, and in 1934 the Société Médico-Psychologique of Paris awarded him its Prix Trénel

pmc-13524758.title: CLEC-1 promotes early IFN response in cDC1s and favors immune dysregulation during sepsis in mice
pmc-13524758.creator: Thomas Teja Ogor, Esther Porée, Javier Saenz, Marion Davieau, Victor Gourain, Camille Ligeron, Florian Pierre Martin, Cynthia Fourgeux, Claire Chédeville, Julie Mignon, Martin Braud, Aurélie Moreau, Régis Josien, Aurore Morello, Etienne Foucher, Nicolas Poirier, Jeremie Poschmann, Antoine Roquilly,
pmc-13524758.description: SummarySepsis is a life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host immune response, characterized by both hyperinflammation and immunosuppression. Here, we show that the absence of the C-type lectin receptor CLEC-1—expressed particularly by lung cDC1s—improves mouse recovery following E. coli infection.

pmc-13552733.title: DEMANet: A dehazing enhanced multi-branch attention network for remote sensing images
pmc-13552733.creator: Peixue Liu, Shu Liu, Pengfei He, Guoheng Wang
pmc-13552733.description: Haze represents a key constraint on the application of optical remote sensing imagery. It not only impairs visual quality but also lowers the accuracy of remote sensing interpretation tasks such as classification and change detection. To tackle this issue, we present a Dehazing Enhanced Multi-branch Attention Network (DEMANet) for effective remote sensing image dehazing.
